subject: Bridge statement request — clarification on post-report change to ingestion pipeline
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@stellarrx.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: compliance@stellarrx.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for bridge statement and clarification re: ingestion pipeline change

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2026-06-30). Our audit team flagged a post-report configuration change to your data ingestion pipeline that took place on 2026-07-15 (minor schema migration + new ETL job). To complete our third-party assurance file we need two things: a short bridge statement confirming that controls remained effective from 2026-07-01 through today (or identifying any exceptions), and a little more color on the July change to determine whether it is in-scope for our risk assessment.

Can you provide:
- A bridge statement that covers 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-18 (or guidance on a different end date you prefer).
- Whether the July 15 change materially altered control objectives tied to ingestion (authentication, data validation, segregation of duties).
- Any control-owner attestations or remediation tickets if there were deviations.

We attached a short template that our compliance reviewers usually accept — happy to accept your custom wording. Our timeline is tight: if possible, can we get a draft within three business days?

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Senior Risk Analyst
StellarRX

Attachments: stellarrx_bridge_request.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@stellarrx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for bridge statement and clarification re: ingestion pipeline change

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and for flagging the timeline. Looping in Karthik (security/infrastructure) and Marissa (compliance) to help validate details and draft the attestation.

Quick answers up front:
- We can provide a bridge statement covering 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-18.
- At a high level the 2026-07-15 change was a schema migration and deployment of a new ETL job that did not change authorization or role mappings; it introduced a new validation step to drop malformed records earlier in the pipeline.

Next steps we propose:
1) Karthik will confirm whether any control tests would be impacted and surface control-owner attestations.
2) Marissa will review the wording in your template and produce a Redwood bridge statement draft that includes signatory details.
3) We will attach supporting artifacts (change summary, deployment runbooks, and control owner attestations).

We aim to send a draft by Tue, 2026-09-21. If that works for you, we’ll proceed.

—Vanessa
Director, Customer Trust & Risk
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: pipeline_change_summary_202606_to_202609.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for bridge statement and clarification re: ingestion pipeline change

Vanessa / Marissa — I reviewed the July 15 change and spoke with the SREs and the data platform team. Below is a concise technical summary you can include as an exhibit if StellarRX asks for more detail: 

- Change date: 2026-07-15 (deployment 2026-07-15T02:43:00Z)
- Scope: Added ETL job v2 to perform early validation + schema mapping. No change to IAM roles or service principals; authentication uses the same KMS-backed service account.
- Controls review:
  * Authentication & access control: unchanged (no new principals granted).
  * Data validation: strengthened (introduced additional automated checks).
  * Change management: standard PR + CI/CD pipeline, approvals recorded (JIRA INFRA-9176).
  * Monitoring: alerts for ETL failures added, logs retained per retention policy (90 days).

Control owners have prepared attestations confirming no exceptions during the post-report window. I’m attaching the control-owner attestation packet and the deployment runbook extract for 2026-07-15. I recommend the bridge statement state that controls remained effective and reference the attached exhibits and JIRA ticket.

—Karthik
Sr. Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: control_owner_attestations_aug2026.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@stellarrx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed bridge statement and evidence package for StellarRX — please review

Hi Emily — thanks for waiting. Please find our proposed bridge statement and supporting artifacts attached. High-level summary below: 

Proposed bridge statement (excerpt):
"Redwood Inference confirms that, between 2026-07-01 and 2026-09-18, the controls described in our SOC 2 Type II report (report period ended 2026-06-30) remained in place and operated effectively, except as noted in the attached exhibits. A specific operational change (ETL v2 deployment on 2026-07-15) introduced additional automated data validation but did not change access control or segregation of duties. Control-owner attestations and deployment records are attached for your review."

Attachments included in the package: proposed_bridge_statement_v1.docx, pipeline_change_summary_202606_to_202609.pdf, control_owner_attestations_aug2026.pdf

Questions for you: 
- Is the excerpt above acceptable for StellarRX’s compliance file, or would you prefer a variant that lists the control IDs explicitly?
- Who will sign the bridge statement on your side (auditor acceptance) and do you need an e-signed PDF or a signed letter on Redwood letterhead?
- Is the 2026-09-18 end date OK or would you like a rolling statement to a later date?

If you give a quick go/no-go we can finalize the letter and provide an e-signed PDF within one business day.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Trust & Risk
Redwood Inference
